question: Which items are below reorder level?
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT name_{L} FROM warehouses WHERE warehouse_id=s.warehouse_id), i.sku, i.name_{L}, s.qty_on_hand, i.reorder_level, i.reorder_level-s.qty_on_hand FROM stock_levels s, items i WHERE i.item_id=s.item_id AND s.qty_on_hand<i.reorder_level

question: شنو الأصناف اللي خلصت من المخزون؟
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT name_{L} FROM warehouses WHERE warehouse_id=s.warehouse_id), i.sku, i.name_{L}, s.qty_on_hand, i.reorder_level, i.reorder_level-s.qty_on_hand FROM stock_levels s, items i WHERE i.item_id=s.item_id AND s.qty_on_hand<i.reorder_level

question: What is our stock value by warehouse?
gold_sql: SELECT w.name_{L}, (SELECT SUM(qty_on_hand) FROM stock_levels WHERE warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id), ROUND((SELECT SUM(s.qty_on_hand*i.unit_cost_usd) FROM stock_levels s JOIN items i USING(item_id) WHERE s.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id),0) FROM warehouses w

question: كم قيمة المخزون في كل مستودع؟
gold_sql: SELECT w.name_{L}, (SELECT SUM(qty_on_hand) FROM stock_levels WHERE warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id), ROUND((SELECT SUM(s.qty_on_hand*i.unit_cost_usd) FROM stock_levels s JOIN items i USING(item_id) WHERE s.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id),0) FROM warehouses w

question: Who are our top 5 customers in Kuwait?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name_{L}, c.country, COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(i.total_amount),2) FROM customers c JOIN invoices i USING(customer_id) WHERE c.currency='KWD' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(i.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Top 3 customers in Qatar

question: Show monthly sales for the last 12 months
gold_sql: SELECT substr(invoice_date,1,7), COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(total_amount*(SELECT usd_per_unit FROM fx_rates r WHERE r.currency=invoices.currency)),0) FROM invoices GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: شكثر مبيعاتنا هالشهر؟

question: How much did we sell this month?

question: Show the receivables ageing in Saudi Arabia
gold_sql: SELECT bucket, COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(outstanding),0) FROM receivables_ageing WHERE currency='SAR' GROUP BY bucket

question: اعرض أعمار الديون

question: Which invoices are more than 60 days overdue?
gold_sql: SELECT invoice_no, customer_name, currency, outstanding, days_overdue FROM receivables_ageing WHERE days_overdue>60 ORDER BY outstanding*(SELECT usd_per_unit FROM fx_rates WHERE currency=receivables_ageing.currency) DESC LIMIT 10

question: أي فواتير متأخرة أكثر من ٦٠ يوم؟
gold_sql: SELECT invoice_no, customer_name_ar, currency, outstanding, days_overdue FROM receivables_ageing WHERE days_overdue>60 ORDER BY outstanding*(SELECT usd_per_unit FROM fx_rates WHERE currency=receivables_ageing.currency) DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which customers owe us the most?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_name, COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(outstanding*(SELECT usd_per_unit FROM fx_rates WHERE currency=receivables_ageing.currency)),0) FROM receivables_ageing GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 5

question: من أكثر العملاء مديونية علينا؟

question: What open purchase orders do we have?
gold_sql: SELECT s.name_{L}, COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(po.total_amount*(SELECT usd_per_unit FROM fx_rates WHERE currency=po.currency)),0) FROM purchase_orders po, suppliers s WHERE s.supplier_id=po.supplier_id AND po.status IN ('open','partial') GROUP BY s.supplier_id ORDER BY 3 DESC

question: أي أوامر شراء متأخرة عن موعد التوريد؟
gold_sql: SELECT po.po_no, s.name_{L}, po.expected_date, CAST(julianday('2026-09-30')-julianday(po.expected_date) AS INTEGER), po.currency, po.total_amount FROM purchase_orders po JOIN suppliers s USING(supplier_id) WHERE po.status IN ('open','partial') AND po.expected_date<'2026-09-30' ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 15

question: How many Safety Helmet do we have?
gold_sql: SELECT w.name_{L}, s.qty_on_hand, i.reorder_level FROM items i JOIN stock_levels s USING(item_id) JOIN warehouses w USING(warehouse_id) WHERE i.name_en='Safety Helmet'
